soundtracks_desc: Over 500 video game soundtracks, from 90s classics to recent releases. Composers like Nobuo Uematsu, Yoko Shimomura, Koji Kondo, Jesper Kyd, Gustavo Santaolalla and many more. This is the complete list of songs that can appear in Oesti Quest.

about_intro:
A daily guessing game? Are we in 2020? Yep — blame Wordle and its clones. Oesti Quest exists because we're a group of friends who love these daily games, love music, and love video games.
Other similar games exist, like Musicle, but they felt incomplete: not enough variety, not enough genres, we'd already memorised almost every game that came up. So from the idea of having something more interesting and challenging — and from having to fill a GitHub repository — this project was born: a site built around our passion for video games.
about_orteku_bio: A computer enthusiast who has always been into video games and music. Looking to modernise by learning new technologies, one day the thought crossed his mind: "What if I tried making a video game music guessing website?". And ever since, he haven't stopped adding features and improving the game — or at least trying to.
about_vyrka_bio: Known in the group for her legendary grinding and her ancient technique of 半分寝ている労働者. She apply that same dedication to Oesti Quest: searching, listening, and adding songs to the database with seemingly endless patience. A large part of the catalogue exists thanks to her.
